pairs.mapping_check_sql: SELECT o.opportunity_id AS entity_key, COUNT(h.root_account_id) AS n FROM opportunity_snapshot o LEFT JOIN account_hierarchy h ON h.account_id = o.account_id WHERE o.snapshot_date = '2026-09-26' AND o.stage IN (7,8) AND o.is_fraud = 0 GROUP BY o.opportunity_id ORDER BY o.opportunity_id

SELECT o.opportunity_id AS entity_key, COUNT(h.root_account_id) AS n FROM opportunity_snapshot o LEFT JOIN account_hierarchy_bad h ON h.account_id = o.account_id WHERE o.snapshot_date = '2026-09-26' AND o.stage IN (7,8) AND o.is_fraud = 0 GROUP BY o.opportunity_id ORDER BY o.opportunity_id
